capabilities: Automatically move or copy attachments when a note changes folder
Apply skip, copy, or ask strategies for attachments shared by multiple notes
Select destination paths: Obsidian default, note subfolder, same folder, or fixed vault folder
Scan for orphaned and misplaced attachments with cleanup and relocate actions
Apply attachment layout settings across the whole vault from the command palette
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents limitations: link parsing targets standard wiki and Markdown links, the operation log is in-memory only and resets on reload, and orphan scans may miss rare edge-case references.
problem: Obsidian leaves attachments behind when notes are moved, so files drift away from their notes and folder structures become inconsistent over time.
summary: Attachment manager that automatically moves or copies a note's linked attachments when the note is moved between folders, plus orphan and misplaced attachment scans.
